$comment: Real, single-source-of-truth primitive color scale for itunda's design system. Sourced by directly fetching Toss's own official TDS docs (tossmini-docs.toss.im/tds-mobile/foundation/colors), 2026-07-13 -- see docs/TOSS_ARCHITECTURE_FACTS.md §3 for the full sourcing note. green500 is itunda's own already-established value (TDS's full green scale isn't confirmed sourced). This file is read by generate-tokens.js, which writes into marked regions of TdsColors.kt (Android), TdsTheme.swift (iOS), and tokens.css (web) -- everything outside those marked regions (semantic aliases, dark-mode mappings, doc comments) is hand-authored and untouched by generation. Run `node packages/design-tokens/generate-tokens.js` after editing this file.
